description: This file defines the Delete feature for handling the removal of a favorite article in the application. It includes a command, validation logic, and a request handler that processes the deletion of an article from a user's favorites based on the article slug and current user context.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler for deleting a favorite article by slug.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Validates that the Slug in the command is not null or empty.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the process of removing an article from favorites, ensuring the article exists, the user exists, and then performing the removal; it returns the updated article envelope.
